note: px113 (pax#305). Every completed attempt of the two jobs in the ci workflow's runs created 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-09 (121 runs, read in pages of 30), each phase read from the job log's own line timestamps, in seconds rounded up. setup: the job's first line to the suite's step (checkout, apt, the pins' fetches, docker pull). programs: the step's start to its first `program:` line, every program built (yew_build: `mkyew: yew` to the next tool's first line, inside programs). native, release: to the last `built native`/`built release` line (kmain_console and the images). s0: to the Y0/S0 verdict (the Linux side; screen-ref's rows). Each leg, in boot order: to its last row line. post: the step's end to the log's end (the artifact upload, the runner's cleanup). legs: the plan's legs, `all` (every leg) or `native bios` (pr and full). A cancelled attempt's last phase reached is `cut` (a lower bound of that phase, never a completion); phases after it are absent, never zero. `red` lists an attempt's FAIL rows: a red of its own (a build or a session failed), never a timing sample. An attempt a re-run copied counts once.
